details: The cryptocurrency market is experiencing a significant downturn, with Bitcoin dropping below $60,000 for the first time since October 2024. The overall crypto market capitalization has decreased, and the Fear & Greed Index has fallen into "Extreme Fear" territory, currently ranging between 12 and 16. This market weakness is largely attributed to stronger-than-expected US jobs data, which has diminished hopes for imminent Federal Reserve rate cuts. This macro-economic factor has strengthened the dollar and led to a broader risk-off sentiment across financial markets. Consequently, altcoins have also seen considerable declines, with Ethereum dropping over 10% in the last 24 hours.
title: Crypto Market Plunges, Bitcoin Below $60K; "Extreme Fear" Reigns

details: Zcash (ZEC) initially saw a significant price drop following the disclosure of a critical vulnerability in its Orchard shielded pool, which could have allowed the undetectable creation of counterfeit ZEC for nearly four years. This led prominent investor Arthur Hayes to liquidate his entire ZEC position, emphasizing that privacy-focused assets demand "perfection not improbability" due to the inability to cryptographically prove the bug was never exploited before its patch on June 2. Despite the initial crash and Hayes' exit, Zcash has since shown resilience, rebounding over 19% in the last 24 hours, even as Bitcoin and the broader market faced declines.
title: Zcash Rebounds After Bug Scare, Hayes Dump; Bitcoin Drops

details: Etherfi and Plume have launched a real-world asset (RWA) vault with an initial $25 million cap, part of a broader $100 million deployment. This new initiative aims to provide eligible users with access to institutional-grade yield through regulated infrastructure, offering exposure to credit strategies from major financial entities such as Blackrock's iShares AAA CLO and Fidelity's Total Bond ETF. The launch expands Etherfi's yield offerings by integrating traditional financial products with DeFi.
title: Etherfi & Plume Launch $100M RWA Vault with Blackrock, Fidelity Exposure

details: BitMine Immersion Technologies has filed with the SEC to initiate a Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock offering to raise up to $300 million. The capital raised is specifically allocated for acquiring additional Ethereum (ETH), expanding ETH staking infrastructure, and making ecosystem investments. This move mirrors the preferred stock structure pioneered by MicroStrategy for Bitcoin, but BitMine intends to fund its 9.5% annual dividend primarily through ETH staking yields, presenting a different capital structure compared to liquidating underlying assets.
title: BitMine to Raise $300M for ETH, Mirroring Saylor's Strategy
